items.headline: Ex-NC State sports medicine director arrested after indictment
items.description: Former NC State sports medicine director Robert Michael Murphy has been arrested after a grand jury indicted him last week on multiple felony and misdemeanor counts involving the sexual abuse of male student-athletes he had treated.

items.headline: NC State QB CJ Bailey addresses costly fumble vs. Vanderbilt
items.description: In his first comments since he fumbled in the end zone with one second left against Vanderbilt, leading to a shocking loss for the Wolfpack, NC State QB CJ Bailey said he "was trying to get all the clock out. That was my thought. ... I fumbled the ball."
